prediction_question: Hypothetical task this source would support (not taken forward): for a Pollution Control Department (PCD) Air4Thai automatic monitoring station, will next-day mean PM2.5 exceed the Thai 24-hour standard, given the station's own hourly history through day D? Probed to a verdict because Thailand is a tick source.
prediction_time: Would be 23:59 ICT on day D: station history through D knowable, D+1 readings not yet made.
target_definition: Would be mechanical: mean of the station's D+1 hourly PM2.5 values above the Thai 24-hour PM2.5 standard (a published regulatory threshold), the D+1 series excluded from shipped columns.

sources.name: Air4Thai - Pollution Control Department (PCD), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Thailand; catalog entry 'hourly PM2.5 from Air4Thai automatic stations' on the national Envilink data catalog
sources.api: the Envilink catalog lists JSON/XML API resources for nationwide and Bangkok-metropolitan station data (65 and 19 recorded downloads); the actual resource URLs sit behind the catalog page, which Cloudflare-walls headless clients (measured 403)
sources.license: unstated on anything fetchable this session (measured); a third-party site asserts 'reproduced with attribution' for Air4Thai data, which is a third-party claim, not a publisher licence
sources.access: no anonymous bulk path measured: catalog page Cloudflare-walled (403 to curl), air4thai.pcd.go.th fails at TLS from the coordinator (HTTP 000; plain HTTP answers 301), and PCD's own service document describes bulk data as a per-case request service

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-20: the Envilink catalog page returns a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, 5,485-byte challenge page) to anonymous curl, so no licence statement on the catalog entry could be read; air4thai.pcd.go.th is not reachable over TLS from the coordinator (HTTP 000). A PCD service-description PDF (pcd.go.th, read via search) describes bulk air-quality data provision as a per-case request service ('จัดทาชุดข้อมูลตามที่ผู้รับบริการร้องขอ เป็นรายกรณี' - datasets prepared case by case on request, historically delivered on physical media). No open licence found; per the standing rule, unstated terms are not assumed.

measurements.access_probes_2026_10_20: https://envilink.go.th/dataset/air-quality-pm2point5: HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge (5,485 bytes). https://air4thai.pcd.go.th/webV3/api/airquality?limit=5: TLS connection failure (HTTP 000); http:// variant answers 301 (to https, which then fails). https://air4thai.com/webV3/api/airquality?limit=5: HTTP 000. All measured 2026-10-20 from the coordinator.
measurements.catalog_metadata_via_search_2026_10_20: The Envilink catalog entry (read via search snippet) records: update frequency hourly; data source 'automatic air-quality stations from the AQM Thai database'; access condition 'Download'; resources JSON (nationwide), JSON/XML (Bangkok metro); the publisher's history page is http://air4thai.pcd.go.th/webV3/#/History.

rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), reason: three stacked blockers, in order of weight. (1) Access: no anonymous bulk path was measurable - the official catalog is Cloudflare-walled to headless clients, the station host fails TLS from the coordinator, and PCD's own document describes bulk data as a per-request service. (2) Licence: unstated on everything reachable; a third-party attribution claim is not a publisher licence. (3) Task shape: a Thai station-level PM2.5 exceedance task would duplicate the cpcb-aqi-exceedance candidate opened this same session - the bench does not need two same-shape air-quality tasks, so even with access and licence resolved this should wait for an explicit operator decision that a second air-quality task is wanted. Not a rejection: nothing about the source itself disqualifies the task.
next_action: If the operator wants a Thai air-quality task: (1) load the Envilink catalog page in a real browser, record the actual resource URLs and any per-dataset licence statement; (2) obtain written licence confirmation from PCD for redistribution of derived station-day tables; (3) only then reopen, with a novelty check that positions it against cpcb-aqi-exceedance (a second air-quality task must argue why the bench needs it).
